d: An anthropomorphic fox with a lean, athletic build, appearing as a mature adult. The fur is a blend of burnt orange and cream, featuring a thick, voluminous reddish-brown tail with a cream-colored tip and tufted ears. The eyes are a warm amber gold with a confident, mischievous expression. The outfit consists of a minimalist tribal ensemble including a dark brown loincloth with a decorative white bone-like belt, a small woven pouch hanging from the waist, and dark grey fingerless gloves with pale green wristbands. Accessories include a wooden bow and a quiver of arrows with green fletching carried on the back. BODY COLOR: Burnt orange and cream LEGS: Digitigrade with dark brown paws
